subject: Future Tech
title: Bioweapons and Dual Use
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Bioweapons and Dual Use.

hook.text: Anything powerful enough to cure disease is powerful enough to cause it. CRISPR is a textbook dual-use technology.

buildup.text: In theory, gene editing could make pathogens deadlier, more transmissible, or resistant to every known treatment.

discovery.text: Intelligence agencies flagged CRISPR as a potential weapon of mass destruction as early as 2016 in threat assessments.

twist.text: The barrier to misuse is dropping. CRISPR kits cost under $200 online.

climax.text: Oversight depends on voluntary guidelines and national laws that vary widely. No global enforcement regime exists.

punchline.text: The same tool that cures can be turned into a weapon.

quiz.question: When did intelligence agencies first flag CRISPR as a potential WMD threat?
